items.title: Albert Nicholas Interview, 1972-06-26
items.q: Yeah, Louis Russell. George Washington, Louis Russell, and Bingham Addison. Bingham Addison on the end. He was a good arranger also.

ctx.x: But in the band, did anybody arrange?

Yeah, Louis Russell. George Washington, Louis Russell, and Bingham Addison. Bingham Addison on the end. He was a good arranger also. Bingham could arrange without a piano just by his ear. Very good musician. He's a stunning arranging.
Were your arrangements easy to play?
